mapper.insert: insert into user_favorite(user_id, goods_id, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{goodsId}, now())
mapper.delete: delete f from user_favorite f left join goods g on g.id = f.goods_id where f.user_id = #{userId} and ( g.id is null or g.delete_status = 1 or g.status = 0 or g.audit_status != 1 )
mapper.select: select f.id, f.goods_id, f.create_time, g.name as goods_name, g.price, g.image_url, g.stock, g.owner_id, g.status as goods_status, g.audit_status, g.delete_status, g.brand_id, b.name as brand_name, u.username as seller_username, rep.score as seller_rep_score, rep.level as seller_rep_level, rep.positive_rate as seller_positive_rate from user_favorite f left join goods g on g.id = f.goods_id left join brand b on b.id = g.brand_id left join user u on u.id = g.owner_id left join user_reputation rep on rep.user_id = g.owner_id where f.user_id = #{userId} order by f.create_time desc
